tree.age: The tree’s structure and size reflect church age, from seed to established tree.
tree.progress: Branches represent objectives. Light leaves mark distinct saved progress notes or measurements.
tree.outcomes: Gold fruit marks distinct recorded outcomes, even when an objective is reopened or archived. Artwork shows up to 5 fruit and 18 progress leaves; counts show the full record.
tree.quiet: Time away never removes growth. Attention labels indicate where care may help, without changing the tree’s worth.
tree.corrections: Editing an update does not add another leaf. Corrected or deleted records change their representation. Completing the same objective again does not add another fruit.
tree.roots: Roots represent the church’s vision, foundation and community; they are not a completeness score.
tree.responses_count: You recorded {count, plural, one {# response} other {# responses}} in this church’s saved objective conversations. These actions sit alongside the church’s progress.
tree.history_empty: No dated progress or objective conversation history has been recorded here yet.
tree.history_recent: Showing the 12 most recent moments. Open the workspace Journey for the full record.
